title: Reception & Front Desk
subtitle: Registration, appointments, vitals and a live queue that feeds the whole clinic

overview.lead: Reception is where the patient journey starts. The front desk registers walk-ins and returning patients, books appointments, captures intake vitals, and starts visits that flow live into the doctors' queues. Everything the desk does is real-time, so a patient checked in here appears on the right doctor's screen instantly.
highlights: Register walk-in or returning patients and start a visit in seconds
Live queue across clinics — drives the doctor workspaces in real time
Appointment booking against doctors and clinics
Intake vitals captured so the doctor opens a complete encounter
One shared patient record across the whole clinic

queue.title: Live patient queue
queue.description: The desk sees the whole clinic's live queue at a glance — who is waiting, for which clinic, and how long. The same queue feeds the doctors' workspaces in real time, so reception and clinicians always see the same picture.
bullets: OPD / Emergency split with wait visibility
Status at a glance for the whole front desk
queue.impact: Reception and doctors work from one live list — no phone calls, no paper slips.

register.title: Patient registration
register.description: Registering a patient — new or returning — and starting their visit takes seconds: capture identity, pick the doctor and clinic, set the visit type, and the patient is in the queue. Returning patients are matched so their history carries forward.
bullets: Assign doctor, clinic and visit type (OPD / Emergency)
Returning patients matched to their existing record
Visit starts and enters the live queue immediately
register.impact: From walk-in to in-queue in under a minute, with history intact.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.description: Appointments are booked and managed against doctors and clinics from the same desk, so scheduled and walk-in flow are handled in one place rather than a separate calendar tool.
bullets: Book against a doctor and clinic
Scheduled and walk-in patients in one workflow
Feeds the same visit and queue model
appointments.impact: Scheduling lives where the patients arrive — one desk, one tool.

vitals.title: Vitals capture
vitals.description: Intake vitals — recorded at the desk or triage — travel with the visit, so when the doctor opens the encounter the clinical picture is already started rather than blank.
bullets: Doctor opens an encounter that's already populated
Part of the shared patient record
vitals.impact: The doctor starts with data, not a blank chart — faster, safer encounters.

closing.lead: The front desk that keeps the whole clinic in sync
points: Check-ins appear on the right doctor's queue in real time.
One shared patient record from registration through to billing.
Appointments, walk-ins and vitals handled at a single desk.
Every figure here is live from the running system on realistic demo data.
